Package com.example.ecolums

Class AuditLogEntry

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.AuditLogEntry
public class AuditLogEntry extends Object
Immutable record of an administrative action performed on the system.

Stored in the Firestore collection auditLog. Entries are written by AdminDashboard whenever a privileged action is taken, such as changing a calculation metric, modifying user privacy settings, or deleting user data. Entries are read-only once created.

Outstanding issues: None at this time.

      public AuditLogEntry(String entryId, String adminId, String actionType, String targetEntityId, String description, String previousValue, String newValue, com.google.firebase.Timestamp timestamp)
      Creates a new AuditLogEntry.
      Parameters:
      entryId - Firestore document ID.
      adminId - UID of the acting admin.
      actionType - One of the ACTION_* constants.
      targetEntityId - ID of the affected entity (may be null).
      description - Human-readable summary.
      previousValue - JSON-serialized old value (may be null).
      newValue - JSON-serialized new value (may be null).
      timestamp - When the action occurred.
